newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing cut to buy by Piper.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing cut to buy by Piper.

text.p: - Piper Jaffray Monday reduced its rating on Boeing Co to buy from strong buy after concluding that a strong period of relative outperformance for the stock may be over, at least temporarily, analyst Bob Toomey said in a report.
- Fundamentals are still seen as strong and stock viewed as a core holding for long-term investors.
- Stock trading at 20-23 times current year earnings, equivalent to valuations in previous peak order years.
- Stock has risen 235 percent since early 1993, outperforming market for three years, and is showing signs of technical weakness, Toomey said.
